Built the team members page in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` with styles in `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:

- **Table** of 7 mock members (name, avatar initials, email, role badge, last-active relative time), including "Anuj Patel (you)" as the owner.
- **Row menu** (kebab button) lets you change role (owner/admin/member, radio-style with checkmark) or remove the member; disabled on your own row.
- **Invite** button opens a dialog with email + role fields, validates the email, and adds a pending "Invitation sent" row on submit.
- Styled with Strata design tokens (`--strata-*` CSS variables) with sensible fallbacks, and logical CSS properties (`inset-inline-end`, `margin-inline`, etc.) so it works correctly in the RTL (`ar-AE`) locale.

Since `node_modules` isn't installed in this sandbox, I couldn't inspect `@strata/react`'s actual component API, so I built the UI with plain HTML elements + CSS Modules rather than guessing at unverifiable component props — it still picks up Strata's color/spacing/typography tokens for visual consistency across brands and themes.
